# Cleaning `states2016`

```{r}
# Display `states2016.csv`
kable(head(states2016))
```

It seems like `ctrname1` is shorter names and `ctrname2` is the full names of countries. However, if we count for both the names, e.g., "Swaziland" and "Kingdom of Swaziland", then if the phrase "Kingdom of Swaziland" appears in `before2017` it would be counted twice. Therefore, we only need to consider the count for "Swaziland", and other *unique* alternative names such as "Eswatini".

```{r}
delete_repetition <- function(row) {
  for (col in 4:7) {
    names <- as.character(row[3:(col-1)])
    names <- names[!is.na(names)]
    
    if (!is.na(row[col])) {
      if (any(str_detect(row[col], names))) {
        row[col] <- NA
      }
    }
  }
  return(row)
}

states2016 <- as.data.frame(t(apply(states2016, 1, delete_repetition)))

kable(states2016)
```

# Labeling

The function created for counting country mentions also 

```{r}
text_to_country <- function(states2016, before2017) {
  
  # Create dictionary from states2016
  dictionary <- list()
  for(i in 1:nrow(states2016)) {
    calph <- states2016[i, 1]
    names <- unlist(states2016[i, -1])
    names <- names[!is.na(names)]
    dictionary[[calph]] <- names
  }
  
  # Function to count country mentions in text
  frequency <- function(text) {
    counts <- list()
    for(calph in names(dictionary)) {
      count <- sum(
        sapply(dictionary[[calph]], function(name) {str_count(text, name)}))
      if(count > 0) counts[[calph]] <- count
    }
    
    # Handle cases based on counts
    if(length(counts) == 0) return("0")
    max_count <- max(unlist(counts))
    max_countries <- names(counts)[unlist(counts) == max_count]
    if(length(max_countries) > 1) return("0")
    return(max_countries)
  }
  
  # Apply to each row of before2017
  before2017$calph <- sapply(before2017$texts, frequency)
  return(before2017)
}
```

```{r}
# Trimming data frames for use
states2016 <- states2016[-1,] |>
  select(-c(ccode, notes))
```

```{r}
# Apply counting function
labeled_before2017 <- text_to_country(states2016, before2017)

kable(head(labeled_before2017, 100))
```

### Limitations with currect 

- "Democratic Republic of the Congo" will also be counted into "Republic of the Congo"

- “Burma Myanmar” or “United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland” would count the country twice

### Questions with labeling rules

- Can words like “Vietnamese” or “Chinese” be counted?

- Can I count for, e.g., “(blank)Vietnam(blank)” or “Vietnam”? if “(blank)Vietnam(blank)”, many messages without spacing between words would be excluded; if “Vietnam”, “Vietnamese” would be included

- Can absolute frequency also be considered? Many messages only have one single country/capital mentioned once, where the message is mainly not talking about the frequency. 

- Could there be possible typos? “Viet Nam” found once

- count

- Democratic Republic of Congo to DPRC 

- Holy See

- "apple" %in% fruit

- "app" %in% fruit
